segments.name: Tactical communication headsets
products: ruggedized tactical protective and communication headset devices
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells ruggedized tactical in-ear protective and communication headsets and accessories for military, police, law enforcement and civilian users worldwide.
segments.evidence: We develop, manufacture, and sell ruggedized tactical protective and communication headset devices as well as other communication accessories, all of which have been field-tested and combat proven.

revenueModel.text: Revenue comes from selling In-Ear Headsets and communication accessories directly to military, police and law enforcement units via government tenders, and indirectly through distributors, agents and OEM partnerships.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our In-Ear Headsets and communication accessories directly to military forces, police and other law enforcement units around the world. We also sell indirectly, through a specialized network of local distributors in each geography in which we operate, as well as through key strategic partnerships with radio equipment manufacturers.
